prerequisites: V14 run lock: exact upstream commit, checkpoint/BERT hashes, prompts, configuration, precision, versions and runtime flags
GT-free image/query cohort with source split and image hashes; exclude FINAL_SEALED
Raw full_cohort_output.json plus baseline boxes, scores and native query indices with immutable hashes
Reference coordinate/preprocessing/NMS/cropping semantics and complete per-query coverage
Independent reviewer approves this tolerance plan before raw outputs are opened

comparison.count: exact for every query; report separately from boxes
comparison.box_matching: native_query_index; never hide dropped/extra candidates through nearest-neighbor matching
comparison.coverage: 100 percent of the locked cohort; any missing/nonfinite prediction fails

stop_rules: Source/checkpoint/prompt/config mismatch: HOLD, do not reuse the V14 label
Count or box mismatch: report both; no tuning tolerances or thresholds after opening results
Count/density-only PrACo results cannot certify bbox parity
GPU smoke success does not certify frozen parity or benchmark accuracy
